resources.string: Whether messages and calls reach this phone while Ramflux is closed depends on these settings.
Background delivery is unavailable: this phone has no Google Play services. New messages appear when you open Ramflux.
Update Google Play services to receive messages in the background.
Google Play services is turned off on this phone.
Google Play services on this phone can\'t be used for notifications.
Ramflux can\'t register for notifications right now.
Your server does not send push.
The push service is not reachable right now.
Ramflux can\'t open this screen on your phone. Open the app settings and follow the instruction above.
Ramflux needs notifications to tell you about messages and calls.
Messages need a notification channel that is not turned off.
Calls need the Calls channel set to high importance with a sound.
Allow Ramflux to show an incoming call over the lock screen.
Let Ramflux run without battery optimisation so that wakes are not held back.
Background use is restricted for Ramflux. Open the app\'s battery page and choose Unrestricted.
Android has put Ramflux in its most restricted standby group. Opening the app moves it back.
Data saver can stop Ramflux from using the network in the background. Allow unrestricted data for Ramflux.
Turn this off for Ramflux, otherwise Android may stop it and remove its permissions.
Battery saver is on. It can delay messages while it is on.
